## Penguin Solutions to Present at Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference


August 19, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://ir.penguinsolutions.com/files/doc_news/2026/08/1/Penguin-Solutions-to-Present-at-Goldman-Sachs-Communacopia-Technology-Conference-2026.pdf)


FREMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Penguin Solutions, Inc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.penguinsolutions.com%2Fen-us&esheet=54591709&newsitemid=20260819934617&lan=en-US&anchor=Penguin+Solutions%2C+Inc&index=1&md5=422a27a364d259b0c8ca67576c8bb4c0) . (Nasdaq:[PENG](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.smartm.com%2Fstock-information%2Fstock-quote-and-charts%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54591709&newsitemid=20260819934617&lan=en-US&anchor=PENG&index=2&md5=6a1e159fd9a7df1404d105bf2853f1e4) ), the AI Factory Platform Company, today announced that the company will present at the following investor conference:


- **Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference 2026** - Kash Shaikh, President and Chief Executive Officer, will present on Thursday, September 10 at 2:25 p.m. PT.


An event webcast will be accessible on the investor relations section of the Penguin Solutions website at[https://ir.penguinsolutions.com/events-and-presentations/default.aspx](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.penguinsolutions.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54591709&newsitemid=20260819934617&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.penguinsolutions.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&index=3&md5=acdb889179950576048b8efa50fd08c5) and archived on the site for a period of 30 days.


**About Penguin Solutions**


Penguin Solutions (Nasdaq:[PENG](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.penguinsolutions.com%2Fstock-information%2Fstock-quote-and-charts%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54591709&newsitemid=20260819934617&lan=en-US&anchor=PENG&index=4&md5=4bd19293290d78671c85fe768c6167b5) ) is the AI Factory Platform Company. We design, build, and manage next-generation data centers for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers.


With deep design expertise at the intersection of data center AI infrastructure and memory solutions, our Full-Stack AI Factory Platform combines differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner technologies to help customers accelerate deployment, optimize token economics, and maximize the return on their AI investments.


Learn more at[PenguinSolutions.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.penguinsolutions.com%2Fen-us&esheet=54591709&newsitemid=20260819934617&lan=en-US&anchor=PenguinSolutions.com&index=5&md5=018a99ccf28bdcc8ce0f7e9a1214c91f) .
